Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class EquilibriumSolidCo2ReleaseModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.EquilibriumSolidCo2ReleaseModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, ReleaseFlowModel
public final class EquilibriumSolidCo2ReleaseModel extends Object implements ReleaseFlowModel
Pure-CO2 choked short-opening model with an equilibrium gas/dry-ice ambient expansion.

The solid-free restriction rate and throat are delegated to HomogeneousEquilibriumReleaseModel at a pressure two percent above the CO2 triple-point pressure. The delegate must remain choked, so this auxiliary boundary cannot determine the rate. Below the triple-point pressure, the ambient sublimation temperature is solved from the NeqSim Clausius-Clapeyron solid-vapour-pressure correlation. Gas and solid mass fractions then follow from the isentropic lever rule, and velocity follows from stagnation-enthalpy closure.

This model is restricted to pure CO2 with a solid-free throat. It assumes equilibrium, zero slip and one common temperature at the ambient-expanded station. It does not predict particle size, particle slip, nucleation, deposition, dry ice inside the restriction, shocks or atmospheric mixing.
